status: Complete native source quartet and QA; parent final review/export/integration pending
nativeArtPolicy: Every raw/master pair is byte-identical. No alpha cleanup, painting, recoloring, crop, per-pose scaling, source padding or source pixel modification. Separate technical export/QA composites only.
semanticContract: idle/walk-a/carry-or-work/walk-b; opposite leading boots and a distinct two-handed serving action using original cooking utensils. No authored gameplay consumer is established.
generationInterpretation: First walk request specified screen-left leading, but its accepted native result leads screen-right. The second walk request explicitly uses that result as reference and generates the opposite screen-left leading contact. Exact original requests are preserved; semantic review reflects the actual images.
sourceEquipmentContinuity: Original work pose swaps ladle to screen-left hand and wooden spoon to screen-right, with sack set beside screen-right boot. New work preserves this action-specific equipment arrangement. Both new walking poses use the idle sack/ladle arrangement for continuity.
palettePolicy: Preserve olive-green skin, ivory tusks, graying charcoal hair, rusty red coat, cream apron and beige sack, brown trousers and boots, steel-gray ladle and warm wooden grain-marked spoon. No faction recolor or baker equipment.

idle.review: Olive-green older orc-like cook with pointed ears, two short ivory tusks, graying charcoal hair, rusty red coat, cream apron, brown trousers and boots. Screen-left hand grips beige tied supply sack; screen-right hand holds upright metal ladle. Both boots planted. No baker identity or basket.

walk-a.review: Screen-right boot leads heel-first with broad underside visible; screen-left boot supports behind. Sack swings outward in screen-left hand and metal ladle remains in screen-right hand. Same unmirrored face direction and body scale.

carry-or-work.review: Substantial serving gesture: near screen-left arm extends the metal ladle bowl outward at waist height; far screen-right hand grips the source round wooden spoon with grain motif. Two boots brace apart; tied supply sack rests beside outer screen-right boot. Exactly two arms and hands, one per utensil. No invented pot, basket or extra food.

walk-b.review: Opposite walking contact: screen-left boot leads heel-first with broad underside visible; screen-right boot supports behind. Sack and ladle stay in their walking hands. Same unmirrored face direction. The two walking leg silhouettes are clearly opposite.
